business_problem: BT Group needed to improve customer support across EE, BT, Business, Consumer, and internal contact channels by giving customers faster, more personalized answers while reducing the load on guides for routine issues such as travel support and billing queries.
solution_summary: BT Group rebuilt customer support around Sprinklr's unified customer experience platform, which sits behind EE's virtual assistant Aimee and the real-time online chat experience for EE and BT customers. When a customer seeks help, the platform draws on BT Group's data to generate personalised and accurate responses, including travel-support guidance and detailed billing explanations, and it can enrich conversations with product cards and carousels. BT hosts the AI capabilities on a private cloud instance and uses its internal Data Fabric platform to set data policies, privacy controls, and governance for the data used by the system. The architecture is LLM-agnostic, allowing BT Group to choose different large language models for different use cases while using the same contact platform to support customer interactions and free guides to focus on more complex cases.

solution_components.name: Sprinklr's unified customer experience platform
solution_components.role: Provides the customer contact platform that draws on BT Group data, powers Aimee, supports real-time chat, and delivers AI-enhanced sales and support experiences.

solution_components.name: Aimee
solution_components.role: Acts as EE's virtual assistant, handling customer conversations for support journeys such as international travel help and billing explanations.

solution_components.name: Data Fabric
solution_components.role: Sets BT Group's internal data policies and governance controls for the data used by the AI capabilities.

data_flow: Customer questions arrive through Aimee or BT/EE online chat. Sprinklr's platform combines the interaction context with BT Group data to generate personalised answers, billing explanations, travel-support guidance, and rich media responses. The result is served back through chat, while harder cases are handled by guides. Data access is governed by Data Fabric, and the AI stack runs in a private cloud instance with safeguards to monitor misuse attempts.
integration_points: Business, Consumer and internal contact channels
business_outcome: BT Group increased automated support volume and improved customer experience by using Aimee and generative AI to handle more conversations, explain billing charges more clearly, reduce live-chat demand for some journeys, and free guides to focus on more complex issues.
